registration_phase: before oracle, solver warmup and timed calls

design.inputs: 12 distinct base maps:4 structures x 3 sizes21/31/41; no reachability/performance filtering
design.scaled_inputs: all ordinary integer entry costs multiplied by q; S/E/X unchanged, E still free
design.candidate: raw circular f buckets and exact gcd cost-unit normalization; max32768 slots then exact heap fallback
design.matching: same heuristic row_column_tight, same tie, same insertion order; all valid pops/path/counters must agree
design.scaling_control: for each base input/tie, original heap route and valid pop nodes are q-invariant; g/h/f scale exactly by q
design.primary: paired complete-call time gcd bucket minus raw bucket and matched heap; original API is practical strong baseline
design.preparation: matched heap shares h table, gcd and full legal-edge D validation; original API does not pay new-module preparation
design.timing: serial, seeded shuffled tasks then methods within blocks; one untimed warmup per configuration; default GC
design.included: input validation, terrain preparation, all h/D/gcd checks, queue initialization, search and full path/fee ledger
design.excluded: scaled-map construction, independent Dijkstra, validation, trace, serialization, charts
design.interpretation: 7 repeated blocks are not extra maps; q is input cost representation, not an algorithm optimum parameter
design.fallback: retain explicit bucket_fallback; fallback results are not pure-bucket speedups; no posthoc removal of losses
